decisions.reason: The online customer portal is a recent, low-carry-cost option that supports deeper customer collaboration and integrated service, so management would keep it while adoption uncertainty resolves.
The cardboard packaging display solution has already generated a strong positive signal through its 2024 packaging award, so its value looks sufficiently promising to continue.
The quarter-pallet cardboard pegboard display fits the firm's core display business and uses existing capabilities, so the firm is likely to keep this still-young option open.
The small cardboard counter display is a low-risk extension of the product range with modest ongoing costs, making early withdrawal unlikely before more sales evidence arrives.

The large freestanding cardboard information display may have somewhat narrower demand and higher execution demands, but it still aligns with the firm's capabilities and is too new to abandon quickly.
